en: Black‑and‑white postcard image showing a neoclassical villa with a tiled roof, tall shuttered windows, and a columned veranda. The house is surrounded by vegetation and trees, with mountains faintly visible in the background. Printed captions appear at the top indicating the name of the villa and its location in Greece, along with the word 'PANCION'. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is overlaid at the bottom.
